Comment.value: Hobbit Post daily delivery parcel (roadmap: hobbit-post). Issued by q_post_give with locals POST_DAY (addressee 1..5), POST_MIS (mislabelled flag) and POST_T0 (accept epoch for the speed bonus); consumed by q_post_pay. Plot + cursed so it cannot be sold, dropped or traded.

value.0:
A neat brown-paper parcel done up with string and a blob of green sealing-wax, stamped with the Hobbiton post-mark. The address is written in Posco Whitfoot's careful round hand -- though the post-master's labels have been known, once in a while, to wander onto the wrong parcel.

The Shire judges its post by the freshness of the seal: deliver it quick and there's bonus pay in it.
